name: Green Bristle-grass
desc: Green Bristle-grass (Setaria viridis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Setaria viridis is a species of grass known by many common names, including green foxtail, green bristlegrass, and wild foxtail millet. It is sometimes considered a subspecies of Setaria italica.
